core_obligations: Set up the test: the proof denotes the two structure morphisms and takes an arbitrary base change of the whole situation (proof lines 8708-8711)

Transport closedness: the base change of the surjection is again surjective and the base change of the structure morphism of the source is closed, so the preimage of a closed subset of the target is closed in the source and its image under the closed map is closed in the base (proof lines 8712-8719)

Conclusion: the displayed identity of that image with the image of the closed subset under the structure morphism of the target shows that the latter is closed; the additional statement about properness combines this with the definition of properness (proof lines 8719-8720)
proof_roadmap: 设 X 在 Z 上万有闭、f 满。取任意基变换 Z' → Z，则 f' 仍满（跨章引理），p' 闭。
对闭子集 T ⊂ |Y'|，有 (f')^{-1}(T) 闭，故 q'(T) = p'((f')^{-1}(T)) 闭，即 q' 闭；再结合分离与有限型即得 proper。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a surjective image of an algebraic stack which is universally closed over a base is again universally closed over that base, and proper when it is also separated and of finite type (author lemma at source lines 8694-8705, label lemma-image-proper-is-proper). The proof (source lines 8707-8720) takes an arbitrary base change, uses the stability of surjectivity under base change to compute the image of a closed subset through the two structure morphisms, and concludes that the relevant map on topological spaces is closed (proof lines 8708-8719). The transport of closed subsets through the surjection is the content. H2.
